name: agent-orchestration
description: Run a mandatory-autopilot control plane or directly deliver one foreground GitHub issue through two-pass review, verification, merge, staging deployment, and staging verification.

interface.shortDescription: Deliver one issue through verified staging.
interface.longDescription: Runs a project-scoped mandatory-autopilot control plane. The direct SDLC loop selects one foreground GitHub issue, implements it in an owned worktree, caps independent review and remediation at two passes, verifies and merges the unchanged candidate, deploys the exact merged revision to staging, and verifies real staging while preserving evidence, credential, and production boundaries.
defaultPrompt: Make this task the mandatory-autopilot control plane. Finish one foreground issue at a time without approval prompts.
Run same-candidate implementation, verification, and exact-head review in separate tasks; never self-review.
Use $sdlc-loop to deliver one foreground issue through merge and verified staging.
